title: Fully-Loaded Sri Lanka | FREE Excursion to Mirissa
highlights: Experience Sri Lanka’s diversity, from Colombo’s vibrant streets to Kandy’s cultural heart, Yala’s wildlife wonders, and Bentota’s serene beaches.
Admire the ancient frescoes of the Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offering stunning views.
Enjoy an exhilarating jungle safari at Yala National Park and get an opportunity to spot a diverse array of wildlife.
Stroll around Kandy Lake, which reflects the surrounding hills and temples, offering a peaceful escape amidst the vibrant heart of Kandy.
Marvel at the Galle Fort Lighthouse, an iconic symbol of Sri Lanka's maritime history, offering breathtaking views over the Indian Ocean.
overview:
About the Tour
Sri Lanka has it all the golden beaches, rising waves, misty mountains, mighty elephants, stealthy leopards, giant whales, a majestic past, lovely tea and warm smiles. 
Visit this beautiful laidback capital with lush green forests, sprawling mountain ranges, the meandering Kandy Lake, and an array of distinguished colonial buildings. Climb the 1200+ stairways perched on a slab of rock over the forests standing tall Sigiriya is accessed by way of passageways cut into the rock face between a monumental pair of lion paws. Moving further, Yala National Park offers the greatest diversity of animal and birdlife in the country, from freshwater lakes to beaches, rocky outcrops to green plains and jungle. This creates an area of immense biodiversity and is one of the world’s most popular destinations to spot the elusive leopard. The unique picturesque lagoon landscapes with the rural palm fringed set up adding to the charm of Bentota. Relax at your hammock with the breezy views at Bentota and quench your adrenaline rush at Mirissa. Conclude your tour by exploring the capital city Colombo which is a mix of shiny hotels and swanky office blocks, neighboring beautiful red-tiled colonial-era buildings.

Route: Colombo - Kandy - Yala - Bentota - Colombo
Duration: 8 Days & 7 Nights
Start Point: Colombo
End Point: Colombo

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon arrival, get transferred to your hotel. Post check-in and spend the day at your leisure, exploring Colombo on your own. You can discover the historic Colombo Lighthouse and take in panoramic views of the bustling port. Also, you can visit Independence Memorial Hall, an iconic tribute to Sri Lanka's freedom, or visit the National Museum of Colombo, home to an impressive collection of Sri Lankan artifacts.

days.title: Visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Today, after check-out, board your transfer to Kandy. En route, make a stop to visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and witness the care given to orphaned elephants, including feeding and bathing sessions. Upon arrival in Kandy, check-in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, enjoy a scenic drive around Upper Lake and soak-in the panoramic views. Later, enjoy a Kandyan dance performance, showcasing traditional music and vibrant choreography. Later, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Day Trip to Sigiriya
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer for an exciting excursion to Sigiriya. Begin by exploring the renowned Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and admire its ancient architecture. You can climb the stairway carved into the rock face to reach the summit, and upon reaching, soak-in the panoramic views of the surrounding area. Also, admire the remnants of royal gardens, frescoes, and the Lion’s Gate as you ascend. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Yala
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to explore Kandy on a sightseeing tour. Start your visit at the Bahiravokanda Vihara Buddha Statue, where you can enjoy panoramic views of Kandy. Then, explore the Royal Botanical Gardens, home to over 4,000 plant species. Conclude your tour at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of Sri Lanka's most revered Buddhist sites and home to the sacred tooth relic of Buddha. After the tour, get driven to Yala and upon arrival, check-in to your hotel.

items.title: Half Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Jungle Safari in Yala | Transfer to Bentota | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, check-out from your hotel and board your transfer for an exciting jungle safari in Yala National Park. Once there, get a chance to encounter leopards and a variety of other wildlife in their natural habitat. Post-safari, get driven to your hotel in Bentota and check in. Then, spend the day at leisure, where you can stroll through the Brief Gardens or explore the historic Galapata Vihara, a serene temple renowned for its ancient rock carvings. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

items.title: Jungle Safari in the Yala National Park

days.title: Day Trip to Galle & Mirissa
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to witness the blend of history and natural beauty on an excursion to Mirissa. Visit the Galle Fort, home to the iconic Maritime Museum, which showcases maritime history and artifacts. Next, visit Coconut Tree Hill & soak-in the coastal views. Also, spend some time relaxing on Mirissa Beach & exploring the Dutch Reformed Church, offering a glimpse into Sri Lanka's rich heritage. Also, you can indulge in water sports at Mirissa Beach before getting driven to your hotel.

items.title: Excursion to Mirissa on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, after check-out, board your transfer to Colombo. Upon your arrival, get driven to your hotel and check-in. Later, you'll be taken on a sightseeing tour of the city. Begin with a visit to the Lotus Tower and soak-in the stunning panoramic views of Colombo's skyline. Proceed to the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple and admire its beautiful architecture. Next, soak-in the vibrant atmosphere of the Pettah Floating Market and more. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel in Colombo. Post check-out, get driven to the Colombo Airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your amazing trip!
